subject: Crediting matrix and demo-sourced proofflow — OliveTech integration
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@olivetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Partner crediting for OliveTech integration / demo-sourced flows

Hi Kimberly + Camila,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier — we’re excited about embedding Redwood’s runtime into OliveTech Cloud for our managed analytics offering. Before we move into an engineer kickoff we need to lock down commercial guardrails so our Rev Ops team can open the pilot PO.

Two asks to start:
- Can you share a sample crediting matrix that shows how you handle demo-sourced vs. partner-sourced leads and what qualifies for a referral vs. revenue-share?
- OliveTech typically takes a small implementation retainer for pilots; we want clarity on how that retainer is treated for commission/rev-share. For example, is a $15k pilot retainer eligible for revenue-split, or treated as one-off professional services?

If you can draft a short mutual action plan (just milestones + ownership + payment triggers) we’ll use that to circulate a PO.

Attached: short intro deck (we’ll share engineering access after the PO)

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Strategic Partnerships
OliveTech, Inc.

Attachment: olive-intro-deck.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@olivetech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner crediting for OliveTech integration / demo-sourced flows

Hi Sarah — great to meet you on the call. Looping Camila (partner ops) and Ben (integration & commercial ops) to help operationalize.

Short answers up front:
- We maintain a crediting matrix that separates (A) partner-introduced leads (partner owns initial intro and gets referral credit), (B) demo-sourced leads (credit goes to whomever ran/co-hosted the demo), and (C) customer-self-sourced. Revenue-share applies to recurring ARR attributable to the integration under the Rev Share section of the partner agreement; implementation retainers are typically classified as professional services unless we explicitly include them in the pilot rev-share schedule.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach a draft SOW and a barebones crediting-matrix template for discussions.
2) Camila will propose the partner contract clause language for pilot retainers.
3) If we get agreement, we’ll put a short mutual action plan (MAP) in Drive + a DocuSign packet for the basic pilot terms.

Can we do a 30-min alignment tomorrow (Thu) 11am PT?

Thanks — I’ll attach the SOW now.

—
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: MVP-Integration-SOW.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@olivetech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner crediting for OliveTech integration / demo-sourced flows

On Wed, Sep 8, 2027 at 4:18 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Short answers up front:
> - We maintain a crediting matrix that separates (A) partner-introduced leads ...

Quick operational notes from eng/commercial ops perspective:
- We need explicit definitions in the MAP for the triggers that convert a demo-sourced lead into revenue-share-eligible ARR (e.g., signed contract with product clause referencing the integration).
- Proposed demo credit rule: credit to partner only if partner AE is the primary contact or co-hosted the demo AND the opportunity is registered within 90 days of the demo.
- If Redwood runs the demo without partner participation and the partner provided an integration but did not facilitate the sales motion, then partner gets referral credit only (no ongoing rev-share) unless otherwise agreed.

I’m attaching a working spreadsheet (crediting-matrix-v1.xlsx) that maps scenarios to credit types and suggested splits. For pilots we typically do a higher partner share to accelerate adoption (example: 65/35 vs 70/30) and then step down after 6–12 months.

Camila — can you draft the pilot clause language and a short invoice treatment note (PS vs revenue-share)?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: crediting-matrix-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@olivetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Partner crediting for OliveTech integration / demo-sourced flows

Thanks Ben — the matrix is helpful. Two quick commercial proposals from our side to move the PO today:
1) OliveTech proposes a 70/30 rev-share in favor of OliveTech for the first 12 months on ARR tied to the integration.
2) The $15k pilot retainer will be billed as professional services and we are willing to credit 50% of that toward the first-month invoice if the pilot converts to a paid subscription within 60 days.

We’ve uploaded the invoice to our finance portal and included a DocuSign packet for the pilot MSLA. Link below. If we can confirm the MAP and the crediting rules (demo credit = co-hosted / 90-day registration window), finance will push the PO this afternoon.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/OLV-DS-98321
Invoice: Attachment: invoice-OLV-15k.pdf (application/pdf)

—
Sarah Lin
Head of Strategic Partnerships, OliveTech
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@olivetech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Sep 2027 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner crediting for OliveTech integration / demo-sourced flows

Sarah — really appreciate the fast turnaround. We’re aligned on most items; two adjustments from Redwood to finalize contract language:

1) Rev-share for pilot: propose 65/35 (OliveTech/Redwood) for the first 6 months, with an automatic review at month 6 tied to adoption metrics (activation, monthly active endpoints, conversion from pilot to paid).
2) Pilot retainer: accept PS treatment with a 50% credit toward first invoice if converted within 60 days (matches your ask).
3) Demo-sourced credit: agree to the co-hosted demo rule AND require registration within 90 days of the demo. We will require the partner to submit the demo event (date, attendees, recording) into the partner portal to document co-hosting.

Camila — can you prepare a short MAP doc in Drive with these bullets (I’ll link the HubSpot deal: HUB-4521) and spin a DocuSign amendment that reflects the 65/35 pilot split and the retainer credit rule? Ben — please prep the billing note so Finance knows to treat the retainer as PS with conditional credit.

If we can get the MAP and Docusign updated this afternoon, I’ll approve the DocuSign on receipt and we can start engineering access Monday.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting OliveTech into pilot.

—
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
